reason: The analyst ran a single bivariate regression with no controls (coefficient 2.29) and trimmed the outcome. My analysis shows strong selection on pre-period covariates: adjusting for them cuts the estimate to about 0.84 (CI about 0.37 to 1.31), so the reported effect is overstated roughly 2.7-fold and a causal reading is not supported. The report also tested only one specification, with no robustness checks.
